candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Accurate text throughout; legend and pie values transcribed correctly. Word-bank rendered as a table roughly matching layout. Furigana placement mostly correct though the image places furigana only on selected words (A adds some but is consistent). Blanks shown as spaces rather than underscores; minor: missing furigana on some words like 次(つ)いで is present, ok. '（円グラフの数値）' is a descriptive addition but harmless.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Multiple serious errors: first legend item reversed as 夫が中心となって行うが、妻も手伝う (should be 妻が...夫も); '半分ずつ分担して行っている' garbled as '半(はん)ずつ担(になと)いて行っている'. Word-bank table corrupted with invented entries ('を示していることが', 'しょう', 'りんいん'). Invented furigana on many words not glossed in the image (行(い)う vs おこな). Reading 行う as い is wrong. Missing period/structure issues.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Very faithful: legend with fill-pattern indicators, pie values, word-bank table matches image layout with correct furigana (示(しめ), 占(し), 過(す)). Body text accurate with correct furigana placement (行(おこな)う matches image gloss おこな). Blanks rendered as underscores, matching underlined blanks. Minor: pie value order slightly reordered (1.5, 0.4, 1.5).

rationale: C is the most faithful: it captures the word-bank with correct furigana readings, uses underscores for blanks matching the underlined fill-in lines, preserves the legend with fill symbols, and gets furigana like 行(おこな)う right. A is nearly as accurate in text content but omits some furigana annotations present in the image, uses spaces instead of underlines for blanks, and its table lacks per-word furigana; still no significant errors or inventions. B is clearly worst: it garbles the legend (reversing 妻/夫 in the first item, mangling 半分ずつ分担して), corrupts the word-bank with invented fragments, and applies incorrect invented furigana (行(い)う) throughout, indicating both misreading and hallucination.
